zh-Hant.title: 按下停止後，看得到它在潤飾
zh-Hant.body: 講完按停止，文字會亮起一道波，代表 AI 正在潤飾。不想等的話，再按一次就直接插入原文。
zh-Hant.also: 長段文字超過三行時，可以往上捲回去看。

en.title: Watch Parley polish after you stop
en.body: When you tap stop, a wave runs through your words while AI polishes them. Don't want to wait? Tap again to insert the raw text.
en.also: Long dictations now scroll, so you can read back past three lines.
